title: ABOUT US
heading: CK TOOL, OKE's Korean subsidiary
text:
OKE founded in 1996 is total cutting tool maker producing all carbide products and not only listed on china stock exchange in 2020 but also aggressive investment has consolidated its position in the cutting tool market. Now we have just completed 3 plants and equipped over 300 pcs flute machines so that they can produce up to 12 million pcs solid endmills and drills per year. Specially latest making 6 axis machine is able to produce one time, "an endmill in a single step," ensuring stability and accuracy of the products.
We, CK tool guarantee providing customers with innovation tool based on technology of OKE and sales of K-cera and makes a constant effort to lead whole making fields with more stable, efficient and innovation tools.
